summary.text: Erik Johnson is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 11 who took office in March 2024 after a special election and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Johnson won the special Democratic primary for Strafford 11 on January 23, 2024, defeating Jeffrey Salloway, and the special general election on March 12, 2024, defeating Joseph Bazo; he succeeded Hoy Menear.
He advanced from the Democratic primary in 2024 and again on September 8, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election for the three-seat district, he is on the ballot with fellow incumbents Tom Southworth and Janet Wall and Republican Monique Meadows.
